rule: SN8's share over a level: every face stone the part makes (face_pool: in a panel as built, a face or through stone against all four sides of its cell on its face), as R1 laid them (masonry.lay at the pinned commit), each at its level's far edge (L0 8 m, L1 20 m) in the judging view (face-on to its face, 20 degrees of top), its front-facing triangles pooled; every other check on each stone

vertices.note: total: the part's own vertices (positions, shared where one); indexedTotal: corners identical in every channel counted once (what an exact indexed mesh needs under the contract); fbxTotal: the FBX route's, three a triangle

shareRule: SN8 sets its 10% over a level's front-facing triangles at its far edge, the fills included: the gully's whole level (walls, copings, fills and steps), which R2b lays and R3 measures. This part's stones alone are reported here against it; the export holds the gully's pieces pooled over every part's pool (level_gate), and every stone's other checks (ok)
